mapping.albedo: linear vertex color times base-color factor and optional sRGB image
mapping.normal: four-weight posed tangent-frame normal maps with authored scale and handedness
mapping.orm: roughness/metallic factors times independently enabled data maps; authored AO strength
mapping.factionMask: explicit vertex factionMask, independent of color
